paper_title: Constraints on dark photon dark matter from Lyman-$α$ forest simulations and an ultra-high signal-to-noise quasar spectrum
notes: Paper sets new 95% CL upper limits on dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon vs mass mA' ~ 1e-13 to 1e-12 eV, from Lyman-alpha forest tPDF of quasar HE0940-1050 compared with hydrodynamical simulations (Fig. 7). No numerical table is provided; the exact limit values are only shown graphically. Data points here are approximate estimates: constraints are only reached for log10(mA'/eV) = -13.15, -12.9, -12.65, -12.4 (paper explicitly states the lowest mass -13.4 and masses >= -12.15 are NOT constrained within the explored grid, log eps in [-15.0, -13.5]). Epsilon values estimated consistent with the statement that the Bolton+22 best fit (mA'=8e-14 eV, eps=5e-15) remains allowed at 95% CL, and with the simulation grid range. This is a cosmological/IGM-heating bound assuming dark photons are all of DM (cosmological abundance), so no local DM density is set.
